title: Bros Attacks
subtitle: Cooperative techniques filed by Waluigi
description: A Bros Attack is a coordinated maneuver in which two allies spend timing, positioning, and trust to produce an effect neither could reliably make alone. The archive currently contains two confirmed techniques.

clearing.name: Clearing
clearing.summary: One partner creates height or leverage so the other can cut, break or force a way through.
clearing.doctrine: The lifter owns the footing, the cutter owns the arc, and neither counts out loud.
clearing.sourceNote: Named for the Feyward corridor cut, where a countdown nearly caused friendly fire and a shared rhythm succeeded.

support_fire.name: Support Fire
support_fire.summary: One partner controls the sightline and the timing; the other delivers the shot and resets.
support_fire.doctrine: The caller is responsible for the miss. The shooter is responsible for the reset.
support_fire.sourceNote: Named for the manoeuvre Green T taught Remi from a printed sheet and used against a barricaded door.

lift_carry.name: Lift and Carry
lift_carry.summary: Moving a person or a heavy object that one character cannot move alone — under fire, or under protest.
lift_carry.doctrine: Decide who is carrying before you pick anything up. Arguing mid-lift is how people get dropped.
lift_carry.sourceNote: Recorded three times: Toadsworth and Thornpaw lifting the frozen Luigi block, Markop's firefighter carry of Remi, and Lanky taking Koffin-K around the middle with Bulky piling in behind.

shieldwork.name: Shieldwork
shieldwork.summary: One partner holds a line or absorbs an attack so the other can act without being interrupted.
shieldwork.doctrine: Hold the rim, brace the wrist, and shove — a shield that only blocks is half a shield.
shieldwork.sourceNote: Named for Remi holding the cottage line during the imp ambush, shield rim biting her wrist while she shoved the invisible attacker back.

misdirection.name: Misdirection
misdirection.summary: One partner manufactures a distraction so the other can move, strike or slip past unobserved.
misdirection.doctrine: The distraction has to cost something to be believed.
misdirection.sourceNote: Named for the Platform Four bypass — combined steam distraction and a theatrical toe-injury covering a manual flux purge.

attacks.name: Support Fire Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Green T and Remi's barricaded-door technique
attacks.description: One partner steadies the shooter's aim, adjusts her position, and calls the timing so the shot lands with greater force and accuracy. Green T taught Remi the maneuver from a simple instruction sheet. Remi immediately used it against the tanuki behind a barricaded bathroom door, making the technique effective and the circumstances disastrous.
steps: Choose the shooter and the partner providing the brace or timing call.
The support partner corrects stance, sightline, and target timing.
The shooter waits for the call rather than firing on impulse.
Resolve the shot with improved coordination, then account for the moral and tactical consequences.
attacks.risks: The technique improves a bad decision as efficiently as a good one. A clearer shot does not make the target lawful, safe, or deserving of being shot.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Green T managed to turn mentorship into a firearms incident before the ink on the instructional sheet dried. That is not a failure of coordination. That is coordination working for the wrong sentence.

drill.promptDescription: Green T lines up the shot and calls the moment. Remi fires, then resets safely.

steps.title: Steady the aim
steps.instruction: Hold Space (or hold the button). Release the instant the charge meter is in the green zone.

steps.title: Call the timing
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press → (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Fire
steps.instruction: Wait for GO, then press Enter (or click) immediately. Too early or too late misses.

steps.title: Reset safely
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↓ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

attacks.name: Chop Bros
attacks.subtitle: Hjumpik and Toad Lee's twenty-five-foot corridor cut
attacks.description: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee to vine-height while Toad Lee chops through the growth ahead. The first attempt failed because Toad Lee was too heavy. The second nearly produced friendly fire after a countdown. The third worked when they stopped counting and found a shared rhythm, opening twenty-five feet of corridor and pushing the leaves back.
steps: Hjumpik establishes a stable lift and carries Toad Lee into cutting range.
Toad Lee keeps the axe clear of Hjumpik and the Guard.
Both partners move by rhythm rather than a shouted countdown.
Advance through the opened growth and stop before exhaustion turns the lift into a drop.
attacks.risks: The lift is heavy, the axe has a wide arc, and a countdown can make the swing arrive before the body is ready. The technique requires trust and room to fail safely.
attacks.result: Verified success: twenty-five feet of corridor opened; a large amount of leaf growth pushed back; the party reached the window and climbed upward at the end of the engagement.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Attempt One failed on weight. Attempt Two failed on numbers. Attempt Three succeeded when the bros stopped performing the maneuver and started listening to each other. I hate how instructive this is.

drill.promptDescription: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee. Toad Lee chops the growth. The pair advances through the opening.

steps.title: Lift Toad Lee
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↑ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Chop down
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↓ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Chop down again
steps.instruction: One more — press ↓ (or click) when the marker hits the green zone.

steps.title: Advance
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press → (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.
